title: Riverboat life on the Sidney with Fate Marable
summary: Life on the excursion boat compared with unloading cotton and banana boats; he mentions tunes he has written.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: And when you got on the riverboats, what was the life like?

Well, it's just the idea that I was on a nicer boat, because I knew the life of riverboats before I got on the steam of Sydney, where Fate Marable used to play the Calypies and things. But before that, we used to unload cotton boats, banana boats. See? I always had the idea of boats, but this was like a dance hall, an excursion boat. And when I got in that band, I kind of feel like I'm a little high up on the horse, you know? You're a composer too, though. Yeah, I wrote a lot of tunes. I wrote Wish I Could Stream Like My Sister Kate, and I play this Stenrichson Barbecue every night. I keep one of my numbers in. But I don't have time to write tunes now. We're traveling so much.
